notes: Names printed without suffix (BOSCH ST. aside: VALLEY, STRAIGHT, ALFRED, DRAPER, COOK) recorded with 'Street'; no bracketed old names on this half. Marshall Av runs along the top edge with its north line off the paper: every Marshall point is the south line (y~213-250) minus half the printed 60' (97 px at ~3.2 px/ft). Queen City Av runs along the bottom with its south line beyond the neat line: Queen City points are its north line (block corners, y~7480-7500) plus 97 px. Straight jogs at Valley: west of Valley it is a 30' street (lines 2138/2223 at Garrard, 2146/2236 at Valley), east of Valley 60' (lines 2055/2238); south lines aligned, centres 45 px apart, so two T points at Valley; the west piece is named 'Straight Street (west of Valley)'. Draper also jogs at Valley: east of Valley 60' (lines 5650/5848), west of Valley an unlabelled 50' street from Garrard to Valley (north line 5747 solid, south line 5910 dashed, possibly not opened) with centre 76 px further south; named 'Draper Street (west of Valley)'. Alfred has no street west of Valley (the line at y~4085 there is a property line with a green outline). Valley/Marshall recorded as T: only the railroad track in Valley continues north of Marshall, and the top paper edge is just above Marshall's centre. Valley has a railroad siding in it; Valley points are the middle between the block lines, not the track. An unnamed 50' street leaves Draper northward at x~3700 (between Valley and Spring Grove) and stops at y~5090; north of that a strip marked VACATED continues to y~4400; not recorded (unnamed, vacated). Colerain Av and Cook St run into the gutter at the right: Colerain/Straight, Colerain/Alfred, Cook/Draper and everything else east of the fold are on 22-16R only. Gutter overlap ties with 22-16R: Colerain/Marshall, Colerain/Heywood, Cook/Alfred, Spring Grove/Queen City. Near the fold (x>5600) the paper is compressed: Colerain is only ~160 px wide at Heywood instead of ~195.
